shoulderCapDefinition: Only the outer proximal skin/sleeve caps; internal Y=6 fist/forearm seam is excluded. Depth-visible cap pixels are compared against actual hand/item union.
limitations: Illustrative lighting and opaque depth raster; no actual client lighting, GPU face-culling, camera bob, HUD configuration, latency or feel acceptance.
